content: {"findings":[{"file":"index.js","line":208,"severity":"major","message":"The regex change introduces an off-by-one error: the maximum length for the hostname portion after the first label is reduced from 63 to 62 characters ({2,63} -> {1,62}), which can incorrectly reject valid hostnames where that portion is exactly 63 characters long. Additionally, the minimum is reduced from 2 to 1, contradicting the comment stating TLDs should be at least 2 characters (though the comment also notes single-character TLDs are technically possible). The regex structure itself only validates the first label's length (1-63) and the aggregate length of the remainder, not per-label limits."}]}
